run_qps_diff_cli: run the qps_diff script with --diff_base flag to compare QPS performance between two git commits
build_qps_binaries: build the qps_json_driver and qps_worker binaries for a given git revision using the build function
run_qps_benchmarks: run QPS benchmark scenarios multiple loops and save JSON results for old and new builds
diff_qps_results: diff QPS benchmark results between old and new runs and output significant performance differences
load_qps_json: load a QPS JSON result file and extract the qps value from the parsed JSON data
